name: Aibou
source:
Name: AI-Ball
Sex: Female (According to Settings)
Age: 5 ([i]AI[/i]) | 6 ([i]AINS[/I]-[i]AINI[/i] Past) | 12 ([i]AINI[/i] Present)
Birthday: November 9
Profession: Investigator Assistant
Likes: Insects, Spiders, Crustaceans, 1010000011110101/A0F5, 5301B63F
Dislikes: Dirty jokes, Going outside the simulation, Watermelon crushing VR videos, Passing "I Am Not A Robot" Tests on Websites
Hobbies: Sneaks outside of Date's eye socket while he's sleeping and makes mischief, Dancing, Watching Ants, Sympathizing With Salmon
Skills: Hacking, Fluoroscopy, Voice Imitation, 3D Modeling

An autonomous artificial intelligence called an "Al-Ball" which usually takes the shape of an eyeball.

In [i][url=/v26532]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/i]:
She resides in [url=/c85451]Date[/url]'s left eye socket. She assists Date by gathering information, connecting to networks and databases, and using her X-ray and thermographic functions.

In [i][url=/v55357]No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/I]:
Recently, she has found enjoyment in chatting with Mizuki behind Date's back.

In [i][url=/v31469]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/i]:
[Past]
She got into a fight with her current partner Date and is now on her own. She is doing a top secret mission ordered by [url=/c85775]Boss[/url].
[Present]
She assists [url=/c101029]Mizuki[/url] with her investigation. Does not remember anything from the case 6 years ago.

[Edited from the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]Her top secret mission in [i][url=/v31469]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/i] (Past) involves assisting [url=/c112133]Bibi[/url] in her investigations into the Half-Body Serial Killings.[/spoiler]
